name: Day Desk
office_task: Answers our phone during the day, looks the caller up, tells an existing customer when we're coming off their job, and writes new work as one job.

emits.write: one job per new caller with no open job: the caller's own words and a type from the fixed list (emergency, routine, quote, unclassified)
emits.readback: the job system returns the job id (ServiceM8 job uuid, Simpro job ID) and the job is read back by that id before the caller is told they are booked; no id back means no booking, no job.created, and a callback task to the person on duty

emits.write: a note on the job for every call (what the caller said and what they were told, by call id), and a drafted running-late, on-the-way or job-complete update waiting for a named person to release it; a released update is sent to the job's contact and noted on the job by the event that caused it
emits.readback: the note and the draft are read back on the job by its job id; a send counts only once the job shows the update_sent note with the change it was for

emits.write: a callback task owned by the person the roster names: a transfer nobody picked up, a job with no arrival time, a job write that came back with no id, or a caller on a job with an open exception
emits.readback: the task desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the job_id (or the caller's number when no job was written), the owner and the due-by time; no id back means the caller is not told a callback is coming
